adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the diff. Looking at line 147-149 in GoogleCalendarService.ts, the code uses `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` to select the calendar. If a legacy destination calendar has `credentialId: null`, this find operation will never match it (since `null === credentialId` where credentialId is a number will be false). The code then falls back to `calendarId: selectedCalendar || 'primary'`, which would use 'primary' instead of the configured destination calendar. This is a real correctness issue where legacy bookings with null credentialId would write to the wrong calendar.
